builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: Damage over time and a Voidwalker to hold the enemy. You start a fight, then watch it fall. Slow and safe, with little to learn.
builds.gear: Stamina and Intellect first, then gear that adds Spell Damage. A staff, or a one-handed weapon with an item for your other hand, and a wand.

why.Improved Corruption: Corruption casts faster and hurts more.
why.Improved Drains: Your Drain spells do more, and Drain Life heals you more.
why.Fel Concentration: Being hit is less likely to interrupt your Drain spells and Wrack.
why.Nightfall: Sometimes your next Shadow Bolt casts much faster.
why.Siphon Life: A spell that slowly takes health from the enemy and gives it to you. It opens Wrack.
why.Soul Siphon: Drain Life and Wrack hurt more for each other Affliction effect on the target.
why.Malevolence: Your Shadow spells critically strike more often.
why.Shadow Mastery: All your Shadow spells do more damage and drain more life.
why.Wrack: A strong over-time spell that also boosts your other Shadow damage over time.
why.Demonic Embrace: More Stamina, so you have more health to survive with.
why.Improved Voidwalker: Your Voidwalker's own spells work better, so it protects you more.
why.Fel Vitality: More Health and Mana for your demon, and more Mana for you.
why.Master Summoner: Summoning a demon is quicker and costs less Mana.
why.Grim Reach: Your Affliction spells reach 20% further, so you can start fights from safer ground.

fight: Summon Voidwalker first. It stands in front and takes the hits.
Cast Corruption and Bane of Agony on the enemy, then Shadow Bolt until it falls.
Mana low? Use Life Tap to turn health into Mana, but only when you are healthy.
Drain Soul drains the enemy while you hold it. If the enemy dies from it, you get a Soul Shard.
Put Siphon Life on the enemy early. It slowly gives health to you.
Add Wrack to the enemy. It makes your other damage over time spells hurt more.
Losing a fight? Cast Fear on the enemy, then step away and recover.
